title: Baby Cost Calculator
description: Estimate first-year baby costs from editable monthly and one-time line items.
howto: Review the default line items and edit any monthly or one-time cost.
Add your own items or remove ones that do not apply.
Monthly items are multiplied by 12 automatically.

faqs.q: What is included in the defaults?
faqs.a: Common first-year items: diapers, feeding, clothing, childcare, medical, and one-time gear. Edit everything to match your situation.
No. It estimates out-of-pocket costs only, not unpaid leave or reduced earnings.
It is a planning estimate. Childcare alone varies enormously by city, so adjust the defaults.
